description: In every industry, there are people whose stories reveal what leadership, risk, and purpose look like in real life.

episodes.title: Built for Battle, Built for Business
episodes.summary: What do the battlefield, the boardroom, and the coaching room have in common? Dirk sits down with retired U.S. Army officer and leadership expert Dr. Traci Eisenberg-Rayburn to explore what truly separates great leaders from good managers — why so many high performers struggle after being promoted, and how leaders unintentionally become the bottleneck.

episodes.title: Leading Through the Energy Transition, One System at a Time
episodes.summary: Andrew Dunn, Energy Solutions Director at FENECON USA, on how energy systems, leadership, and policy intersect as the world moves toward cleaner and more resilient power.

episodes.title: The Leadership Test No One Trains You For
episodes.summary: Andy Zaske, Vice President of the Americas at BW Water, on what leadership looks like when there is no playbook, no pause button, and no margin for comfort.

episodes.title: Engineering Trust at Scale
episodes.summary: Bhadresh Sutaria, President of AMSOIL INC., on how AMSOIL differentiates itself through innovation, values, and a deep commitment to customer relationships.

episodes.title: Keeping It Chill When Reliability Is Everything
episodes.summary: Jim VanderGiessen, CEO of Pro Refrigeration, on the industrial cooling systems behind dairy farms, breweries, and food production — where reliability is everything.

episodes.title: The Marine, the Farmer, and the Fight for California's Water
episodes.summary: Marine Corps veteran and California farmer William Bourdeau on water, food security, and why both are leadership issues.

episodes.title: When We Stop Trying to Bottle the Ocean
episodes.summary: Michael Anthonavage, VP of Innovation at Vitaquest, on science, empowerment, and turning complex ideas into practical breakthroughs.

episodes.title: Luck Lives Where Others Quit
episodes.summary: Benoit La Salle, President and CEO of Aya Gold & Silver, on building companies across commodity cycles — and staying the course.

episodes.title: When the Job Ends and the Real Work Begins
episodes.summary: Daryn Walters, former President of Exmark Manufacturing, on a three-decade career across entrepreneurship, manufacturing, and people-centered leadership.

episodes.title: The CEO as the Chief Energy Officer
episodes.summary: Food industry veteran Brian Fox on 35 years across pasta, pizza, meat, and ingredients — and why grit beats talent.

episodes.title: Becoming an Author: The Long Way Around to The Winning Balance
episodes.summary: Dirk shares the story behind his book The Winning Balance — and why it took more than two decades of transformation work to write it.

episodes.title: Better Leadership Already Starts With Saying Hello
episodes.summary: Dr. Mike Horne, executive coach and author of The People Dividend, on why most issues aren't people problems but system problems.

episodes.title: How a Molecular Biologist Learned to Sell Science
episodes.summary: Matteo Marano on bridging hard science and commercial strategy — and why storytelling often matters more than data alone.

episodes.title: Turning Trash into Value
episodes.summary: Emir Avdić, CEO of employee-owned Sebright Products, on turning what companies throw away into new value streams.

episodes.title: From Montevideo to Megawatts
episodes.summary: Alejandro Iza on what it really takes to build reliable solar power in a world of rising demand.

episodes.title: Start with People, End with Yes
episodes.summary: Career strategist Keri-Lynne Shaw, founder of The Salary Bump, on redefining ambition around clarity, confidence, and connection.

episodes.title: When Patina Creates Purpose
episodes.summary: Ivo Caixeiro on a global career from Portugal to New York to Asia, rooted in human connection and adaptability.

episodes.title: Culture Eats Frozen Peas for Breakfast
episodes.summary: Jason Wolcott, Chief Commercial Officer at Twin City Foods, on thriving in a commodity market beyond price competition.

episodes.title: Global by Origin, Intentional by Design
episodes.summary: Vaishali Lara Kathuria of Norges Bank Investment Management on standing out in finance by being intentional about your path.

episodes.title: Keep Your Friends Close and Your Marketing Pro Closer
episodes.summary: Christian Demers on the bold decisions that turned startups into global successes — and balancing vision with execution.
